title: Prism third-party inventory
description: Every external font, icon set, kit, library or reference that Prism touches (ADR-0015 rule 5). `pnpm licenses:check` validates this file, fails when a packaged item's permitted_use is not 'own' or 'adapt-with-attribution', and compares `packaged_as`, `npm` and `swiftpm` with the files the repository packages and the dependencies its published packages declare. `pnpm licenses:notices` regenerates THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md from it.

permitted_use_values.description: Mirror of the permitted_use enum below, so a reader of the file sees the vocabulary; licenses:check fails when the two lists differ.

spdx.description: SPDX identifier or LicenseRef-* for proprietary terms

packaged.description: true when bytes of this item ship inside a Prism package; packaged_as then names the files, and licenses:check compares both directions with the tree

packaged_as.description: Repository-relative globs ('*' inside one segment, '**' across segments) naming the files these bytes ship as. Required when packaged is true; on a packaged: false item it lets the gate fail if those files appear.

npm.description: npm package names this item covers, cross-checked against the dependencies, peerDependencies and optionalDependencies of every published package

swiftpm.description: SwiftPM repository URLs this item covers, cross-checked against the .package(url:) entries of Package.swift
